---
title: Structured elements in Typst, terminal
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: terminal
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: Callouts of each kind, a task list, keys, details, a theorem, a proof and maths compile to a PDF/UA-1 file in the terminal preset, which draws callouts with a label set into the frame, with the task states and the TeX source of the maths as alternative texts.
        check: bash _checks/accessibility.sh elements
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['#metadata\(\(mc-callout: "warning", appearance: "simple", titled: true\)\)', '#mc-task-list\[', '#mc-task\(true\)', '#mc-task\(false\)', '#mc-kbd\[', '#mc-details\(', '#math\.equation\(block: false, alt: "E = mc\^2", ', '#math\.equation\(block: true, alt: "\\\\sum_\{n=1\}\^3 n = 6"', '#math\.equation\(alt: "x \+ 1 = 2", block: true, ']
---

{{< include _elements-typst.qmd >}}
